title: 第一卷 第3章 首杀  可以长生？
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天赋这东西，也没有绝对的高低之分。

就像是刚才那个说自己能够控制屎的。

乍一听像是个绝对垃圾的天赋。

但仔细一想，只要运用得当，这特么简直就是别人的噩梦......

手中的特性石斧没有停歇。

好运并没有一直持续。

在砍第三棵大树的时候，忽然一阵低吼声音传来。

那声音，就像是一个破了的嗓子在发出不甘的吼叫。

手中石斧立马停下，随后看向声音来源之处。

好家伙！

真正见到丧尸的时候，才能理解那些说恶心的人。

这样子实在太特么的恐怖恶心了。

整个身体挂着几条黑黢黢的破布，上面还有粘液在滴落。

全身腐烂的皮肤呈现一种酱紫色的样子，像是某些在梁上封存了几十年的猪肉一样。

那脸上更不用说了，你能看到上面腐肉之间还有蛆虫在翻滚。

秦龙以前看过不少的丧尸类电影。

总觉得击杀丧尸还是比较刺激的。

实际上真实看到丧尸这种东西，别说击杀了。

先被恶心到失去三成战力了。

还好只是出现了一只丧尸。

这丧尸在看到秦龙的时候，一下子激发了他嗜血的本性。

本来慢慢悠悠行走的丧尸，一下子怒吼一声，快速地朝着秦龙这边跑了过来。

可惜他其中的一条腿，上面的骨头似乎是断了，根本跑不快。

既然来到了这样一个满地丧尸的世界，矫情什么的没有用。

紧了紧手中的石斧。

秦龙就躲在这棵大树的后面等待。

有这棵树的阻挡，起码有迂回的能力。

很快丧尸就来到了眼前，恶臭差点没把秦龙熏晕过去。

恶臭熏天的丧尸嘴巴噘着一口黑牙就朝着秦龙咬了过来。

秦龙等的就是这个机会。

快速闪身，从大树的另外一端绕了过去。

丧尸一下子扑了个空，等转头的时候已经来不及了。

秦龙就是在利用这个丧尸腿脚不好的方便。

等丧尸回头的时候，他已经从大树旁边绕到了丧尸的后面。

手中的石斧毫不犹豫地朝着丧尸脑壳砍了下去。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There is no absolute level of talent.

Just like the one who said he could control shit.

At first glance it sounds like an absolutely rubbish talent.

But if you think about it carefully, as long as it is used properly, this is simply someone else’s nightmare...

The characteristic stone ax in his hand never stopped.

The good luck didn't last forever.

While cutting down the third big tree, a low roar suddenly came from the tree.

The sound was like a broken voice roaring unwillingly.

The stone ax in his hand stopped immediately, and then he looked towards the source of the sound.

Good guy!

Only when you actually see zombies can you understand those who say they are disgusting.

This is so terrifying and disgusting.

There were several black rags hanging on the whole body, with mucus dripping from them.

The rotten skin all over the body has a purple color, like some pork that has been sealed on a beam for decades.

Not to mention the face, where you can see maggots writhing among the rotting flesh.

Qin Long has watched many zombie movies before.

I always find killing zombies quite exciting.

In fact, you can actually see zombies, let alone kill them.

First, he was so disgusted that he lost 30% of his combat power.

Fortunately, only one zombie appeared.

When this zombie saw Qin Long, his bloodthirsty nature was suddenly aroused.

The zombie that was walking slowly and leisurely suddenly roared and ran towards Qin Long quickly.

Unfortunately, the bone in one of his legs seemed to be broken, so he couldn't run fast at all.

Now that we have come to a world full of zombies, there is no point in being pretentious.

He tightened the stone ax in his hand.

Qin Long hid behind the big tree and waited.

With the obstruction of this tree, at least he has the ability to make a detour.

Soon the zombies came in front of him, and the stench almost made Qin Long faint.

The stinky zombie bit Qin Long with its black teeth pouting in its mouth.

Qin Long was waiting for this opportunity.

He quickly dodged and went around the other side of the big tree.

The zombie jumped away, and by the time he turned around, it was already too late.

Qin Long was taking advantage of this zombie's poor legs and feet.

When the zombie turned back, he had already walked around the big tree and moved behind the zombie.

The stone ax in his hand struck the zombie's head without hesitation.
